Check candidate positions against the full layout, separator color, and resulting panel extents; prefer the line that explains two coherent, appropriately aligned panels rather than blindly taking the first uniform line. Do not assume a recurring task ID guarantees the same divider axis, colors, or dimensions. Every action must be one supported JSON action on the final line.
